title: Goldfish dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='water' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#1a3a5c'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#0e1f33'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffd23f'/>
      <stop offset='70%' stop-color='#ff9e1b'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e8750a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- bubbles -->
  <circle cx='22' cy='20' r='3' fill='#7fd4f0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='28' cy='12' r='2' fill='#7fd4f0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='2.5' fill='#7fd4f0' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- tail fin, sweeping like a dancer's skirt -->
  <path d='M 62 52 Q 78 38 88 42 Q 80 48 82 52 Q 88 56 80 62 Q 78 54 62 52 Z' fill='#ff7a3d'/>
  <path d='M 62 52 Q 76 44 84 46 Q 78 50 80 52 Q 84 55 78 58 Q 76 54 62 52 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- top fin -->
  <path d='M 34 34 Q 48 24 56 30 Q 48 32 44 38 Q 38 32 34 34 Z' fill='#ff8c2b'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='52' rx='22' ry='15' fill='url(#body)'/>

  <!-- belly highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='58' rx='13' ry='6' fill='#ffef9e' opacity='0.65'/>

  <!-- dancing pectoral fin, raised -->
  <path d='M 40 46 Q 32 34 24 34 Q 34 42 38 48 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>
  <!-- lower pectoral fin -->
  <path d='M 40 58 Q 34 66 28 68 Q 36 64 42 60 Z' fill='#ffb347'/>

  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='47' r='4' fill='#fff6d8'/>
  <circle cx='27' cy='47' r='2.2' fill='#2b1a4a'/>
  <circle cx='26.2' cy='46.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- happy smile -->
  <path d='M 22 55 Q 26 60 32 56' stroke='#c25a00' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- little dancing ziggle sparkles -->
  <path d='M 70 30 l 2 4 l 4 1 l -4 2 l -2 4 l -1 -4 l -4 -2 l 4 -1 Z' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='14' cy='42' r='1.8' fill='#ffe680'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='72' r='2' fill='#ffe680' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
